# KPro v0.1.0

KPro v0.1.0 is the first public developer release of the pre-1.0 Go
application framework. It provides one application-level assembly model across
TCP, KCP, QUIC, UDP, WebSocket, HTTP/HTTPS/HTTP/2/HTTP/3, SSE, and gRPC.

## Highlights

- Checked server construction, transport preflight validation, one-shot
  lifecycle ownership, readiness handles, and bounded graceful shutdown.
- Bounded Router queues and in-flight admission, transport capacity guards,
  stable error classification, and safer protocol boundaries.
- HTTP route groups and route-local middleware, unified message middleware,
  and public `transport/transportkit` extension helpers.
- Optional OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Zap, and health integrations.
- GORM-backed delivery/outbox and projector operational controls, plus database
  adapter lifecycle and health helpers.
- `kpro new`, `kpro doctor`, and `kpro version` developer tooling.
- Cross-platform CLI archives with SHA-256 checksums and per-archive SPDX SBOMs.

## Before adopting

This remains a pre-1.0 release. Pin `v0.1.0`, review minor-version upgrades,
and validate capacity, failure recovery, authentication/authorization,
telemetry backends, and deployment policy for the target application. Message
transport shutdown is bounded but is not a reply-delivery barrier; Redis locks
are single-node token-owned TTL leases, not fencing or quorum locks.

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/saramand9/kpro/blob/v0.1.0/CHANGELOG.md)
and [production-readiness checklist](https://github.com/saramand9/kpro/blob/v0.1.0/docs/production-readiness.md).
